lifecycle.resolvedBody: You can reopen this ticket if the issue has not been resolved.
lifecycle.reopenedBody: You reopened this ticket. It is back with the support desk.
lifecycle.closedBody: This ticket has been permanently closed and cannot be reopened.
lifecycle.deskClosedBody: Permanently closed: it can no longer change or receive comments. Its history stays available.
lifecycle.resolveHint: Resolved: the employee can still reopen it if the issue is not solved.
lifecycle.closeHint: Closed permanently: final — the employee can no longer reopen it.

confirm.resolveTicketBody: This marks the ticket as resolved and tells {name}.
confirm.resolveTicketReopen: {name} can reopen it if the issue has not been solved.
confirm.closeTicketBody: This permanently closes the ticket. {name} will no longer be able to reopen it.
confirm.closeTicketKept: All ticket history, comments and audit records remain available.
confirm.reopenTicketBody: This reopens the ticket and returns it to the support workflow.
confirm.reopenTicketSame: You can keep adding information and comments to the same ticket.
confirm.deleteTicketBody: This permanently deletes the ticket, its comments and its screenshots.
confirm.deleteScreenshotBody: The screenshot is removed from the ticket permanently.

notices.reopenedByYou: You reopened the ticket. The support desk has been told.

errors.supportTicketClosed: This ticket is permanently closed: it can no longer be reopened, changed or commented on.
errors.supportTicketTransitionNotAllowed: This status change is not possible for the ticket as it stands now.
